<?php
class UnionIntStringGet {
    public function __get(string $name): int|string {
        echo $name, ":";
        if ($name === "text") { return "0012"; }
        if ($name === "bad") { return null; }
        return true;
    }
}
class UnionStringIntGet {
    public function __get(mixed $name): string|int {
        echo $name, ":";
        if ($name === "text") { return "9"; }
        return false;
    }
}
$reader = new UnionIntStringGet;
$selector = "text";
echo $reader->$selector === "0012" ? "T;" : "BAD;";
echo $reader->boolean === 1 ? "W;" : "BAD;";
$reader = new UnionStringIntGet;
echo $reader->text;
echo ";";
$selector = "boolean";
echo $reader->$selector === 0 ? "ZERO;" : "BAD;";
$reader->boolean;
echo "D;";
$reader = new UnionIntStringGet;
$destination = 42;
try {
    $destination = $reader->bad === null;
} catch (TypeError $failure) {
    echo $failure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo "DONE;";
